question: Look at this GnuCash screenshot. Give the x,y pixel coordinates of the centre of the 'New' button in the toolbar, and the y of the 'Description' column header. Answer as two lines only.
why: Several Gemini ids returned identical row coordinates, raising the worry that they are aliases onto one checkpoint and therefore not independent evidence. A second, different question separates the two explanations: aliases would agree again, distinct models need not.

answers.gemini-3.1-flash-lite:
New button centre: 304, 158
Description header y: 268

conclusion: They diverge in value and in format, so they are not one endpoint returning the same text. Their agreement on the account-row coordinates is convergence between distinct models, not duplication.
